faq.question: After Class 12, are Indian students able to pursue biotechnology studies in Canada?
faq.answer: Yes . After Class 12, Indian students who meet the academic and subject standards of the institution are able to apply for bachelor's degrees and diploma programs in biotechnology or similar subjects.

faq.question: Does studying biotechnology in Canada need NEET?
faq.answer: For biotechnology programs, NEET is typically not a prerequisite for admission. Academic credentials, necessary courses, and language proficiency are typically used by universities to evaluate applicants.

faq.question: How long do biotechnology courses last in Canada?
faq.answer: A diploma may take about two years, but a bachelor's degree often takes three to four years. PhD programs often take four to six years, while many master's programs take one to two years.

faq.question: How much does it cost to study biotechnology in Canada?
faq.answer: As a general planning estimate, living expenditures and tuition might come to at least CAD 35,100-85,100 annually. The university, program, and city all affect actual costs.

faq.question: After completing biotechnology, can I find employment in Canada?
faq.answer: Graduates can apply for jobs in clinical research, pharmaceutical firms, biotechnology manufacturing, research labs, quality control, and related fields. Qualifications, real-world experience, technological proficiency, work authorization, and the job market all play a role in employment.
